heading: Purpose
lead: The purpose of this part is to promote service-learning as a strategy to—

tree.text: support high-quality service-learning projects that engage students in meeting community needs with demonstrable results, while enhancing students’ academic and civic learning; and
support efforts to build institutional capacity, including the training of educators, and to strengthen the service infrastructure to expand service opportunities.
